_comment: Baseline-model registry for the bake-off UI picker (GET /curation/bakeoff/baseline_models). Empty by default: previous training runs are the baselines, and quantized ONNX variants of a run are produced by the bake-off job's quantize stage. Add external models as entries (schema: docs/design/generic_model_comparison_plan.md section 7.6), give a profile its own registry via baselines_path, or point OP_BAKEOFF_BASELINES_PATH at your own file.
